concepts.title: Definition of Complex Numbers
concepts.definition: A mathematical expression combining a real quantity and an imaginary quantity involving the square root of negative one.
concepts.key_idea: Extension of the real number system to include solutions for negative square roots.

solution_steps.explain: The term without i is the real part, and the coefficient of i is the imaginary part.

concepts.title: Equality of Complex Numbers
concepts.definition: Two complex expressions are considered identical if and only if their respective real parts and imaginary parts are equal.
concepts.formula: a + ib = c + id implies a = c and b = d
concepts.key_idea: Comparing corresponding components to solve for unknowns.
question_patterns: find the value of x given the equality
solve for the unknown real variable in the complex equation
equate the real components to find the unknown
calculate the missing coefficient from the identity
determine the value of the variable by comparing parts

solution_steps.explain: Set the real part of the left side equal to the real part of the right side.

concepts.title: Addition and Subtraction of Complex Numbers
concepts.definition: The process of combining two complex numbers by independently summing or subtracting their real and imaginary components.
concepts.key_idea: Real parts combine with real parts; imaginary parts combine with imaginary parts.
question_patterns: find the sum of two complex numbers
subtract one complex number from another

simplify the sum of the given complex expressions

solution_steps.explain: Collect all terms that do not contain i.
Collect all terms that are coefficients of i.
Sum the real parts and the imaginary parts separately.

concepts.title: Multiplication of Complex Numbers
concepts.definition: The product of two complex numbers calculated using the distributive property and the identity i squared equals negative one.
concepts.key_idea: Expansion using FOIL method while replacing i**2 with -1.
question_patterns: multiply the complex numbers
find the product of z1 and z2

calculate the result of multiplication in a + ib form
simplify the product of the given complex numbers

solution_steps.explain: Multiply each part of the first number by each part of the second.
Replace any occurrence of i**2 with -1.
Combine the resulting real and imaginary terms.

concepts.title: Integral Powers of Iota
concepts.definition: The cyclic behavior of the imaginary unit i when raised to integer powers, repeating every four steps.
concepts.key_idea: Reducing large powers of i by finding the remainder when divided by 4.

concepts.title: Square Roots of Negative Real Numbers
concepts.definition: The representation of square roots of negative values using the imaginary unit i.
concepts.key_idea: Extracting the negative sign as the imaginary unit i.
question_patterns: find the square root of a negative number
express sqrt(-x) in terms of i
simplify the radical of a negative real

solution_steps.explain: Write the negative number as -1 times the positive magnitude.
Replace the square root of -1 with i.

concepts.title: Modulus of a Complex Number
concepts.definition: The non-negative real value representing the distance of a complex number from the origin in the Argand plane.
concepts.key_idea: Magnitude calculation using the Pythagorean theorem on real and imaginary parts.
question_patterns: find the modulus of the complex number
calculate the magnitude of z

determine the distance of the point from the origin
compute the modulus for a + ib

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the real component by itself.
Multiply the imaginary component by itself.
Add the two squared values together.
The modulus is the square root of the sum of squares.

concepts.title: Conjugate of a Complex Number
concepts.definition: A complex number obtained by changing the sign of the imaginary part of the original number.
concepts.key_idea: Reflection of the complex number across the real axis in the Argand plane.

calculate the conjugate of the expression

solution_steps.explain: Locate the sign preceding the imaginary part.
Change positive to negative or negative to positive for the imaginary part only.

concepts.title: Multiplicative Inverse of a Complex Number
concepts.definition: The reciprocal of a non-zero complex number which, when multiplied by the original, results in one.
concepts.key_idea: Using the conjugate and the square of the modulus to find the reciprocal.

concepts.title: Argand Plane Representation
concepts.definition: A geometric plane where complex numbers are represented as points, with the x-axis as the real axis and the y-axis as the imaginary axis.
concepts.formula: P(x, y) corresponds to x + iy
concepts.key_idea: Mapping complex numbers to ordered pairs on a coordinate system.
